assessment: The authors performed transcriptomic analyses from compartment-specific, micro-dissected hippocampal region tissue from transgenic mice. One feature that distinguishes this work from previous FMRP studies is the use of conditional knock-in tags (GFP or HA) and tissue-specific expression of the Cre recombinase to target a population of pyramidal neurons in the CA1 region. The strengths of the paper are the rich datasets and innovative integration of methods that will provide a valuable technical resource for the field.
